verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents every step of the headless agent flow. The DuckDB CLI and SDKs connect directly, and credentials can be saved locally so sessions don't re-authenticate. The remote MCP server lets an agent explore schemas, tables, and columns and run read-only or read-write SQL. Governance comes from a read-only restriction, SaaS Mode, and role-scoped Shares, and a Postgres endpoint offers another non-dashboard path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the full flow; detail on fine-grained governance such as audit logging or agent-specific credential scoping.
